summary: Hardin County TX tower at Saratoga, listed gone in the FFLA index; no build, staffing or fire history found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists Saratoga as Tower Gone; no removal date or site description found

notes_for_editor: Very thin: the FFLA index is the only source that mentions a tower. The TSHA town entry, read in full, says nothing about a lookout, and a Texas Escapes page on Saratoga does not mention one either. The story is well under the 120-word floor because the sources say no more; it was not padded with town history. Lead, not used: a TAMUS-TFS archive item (edocs.tamu.edu, id 1997) appeared in search results with a title describing a 1950-11-15 record of a three-legged steel lookout tower at Saratoga, TX. Its WebLink viewer needs cookies, so both fetch_text and WebFetch failed and nothing from it is cited. Worth a retry by a person with a browser session, since it could give the build and era. Budget used: 2 WebSearch, about 5 fetch_text reads, 1 WebFetch.
